$comment: Layout of docs/DSL_KEYWORD_REFERENCE.md: which model.schema.json $defs entry is documented under which of the twelve nouns of docs/adr/ADR-0013-twelve-nouns.md. Read by scripts/docs/generate_dsl_keyword_reference.py; every $defs entry must be placed exactly once (the generator refuses otherwise). Everything here is rendered into a product document, so it is English.
rootIntro: A model file is one JSON object. `namespace` and `concepts` are required in every model (the schema also requires `version`); everything else is optional. Each array below holds objects of the kind named in its type, and every array of object kinds also accepts an entry of the form `{"$ref": "relative/file.json"}` that pulls that item from a local file next to the model. The keys are grouped by the twelve nouns of the vocabulary in the sections that follow.
packIntro: A pack file (`pack.json`) is a named, versioned bundle of the same kinds of members a model declares (concepts, flows, capabilities, roles, screens, ...) that other models consume through the `packs` root key. The member arrays have the same shape as in a model; the keys that only exist in a pack file describe the pack itself (identity, dependencies, publishing metadata).

nouns.title: Concept
nouns.intro: A kind of record the app stores: its fields, lifecycle, invariants and who may read or write it. This section also holds everything that belongs to describing data: field types, reusable domain types, numbering sequences, first-boot seed rows, row and field level access, presentation hints and aggregates (a root concept that owns child collections read and saved as one unit).

nouns.title: Query
nouns.intro: A named, parameterised, permission-aware read over one concept: filters, ordering, joins through reference fields, grouping and aggregates. Screens, panels, flows and agents run queries by name.

nouns.title: Flow
nouns.intro: Something the app does: an ordered list of steps started by a trigger (an API call, a screen button, an event, a schedule, a webhook or another flow). Flows are durable, can wait for events or human tasks and can compensate on failure. The legacy procedure kinds at the end of this section are being retired in favour of flows.

nouns.title: Event
nouns.intro: A named fact that happened, with a payload. Flows emit events and can be triggered by them or wait for them; a capability's inbound door publishes one per verified webhook delivery.

nouns.title: Function
nouns.intro: A named, pure, typed computation callable from any expression. Each call is replaced by the function body at compile time, so functions cost nothing at runtime.

nouns.title: Capability
nouns.intro: A door to the outside world: outbound operations (an HTTP API, a payment provider, a code extension, an AI vendor) and inbound webhooks. Operations carry a contract, an execution policy (retries, timeout, circuit breaker, idempotency) and an auth requirement.

nouns.title: Role
nouns.intro: A kind of user and what that kind may do. Roles are the anchor of default-deny authorization. This section also holds `agentAccess`, which decides what an AI agent acting for a user is offered (an access rule set documented next to roles).

nouns.title: Experience
nouns.intro: What one group of roles sees when it signs in: the device it targets, the screen it lands on and its navigation. This section also holds the optional configuration of the generated back office (menu groups, default route, dashboard pages).

nouns.title: Screen
nouns.intro: One screen of the app. The `screen` kind is the current, closed set of archetypes (list, detail, form, status, inbox, board, map, dashboard, workbench, document, picker, custom). A hand-written panel is the `panel` block of a `custom` screen (data sources, layouts, field bindings) and a concept's generated pages are the `admin` block of a `list` or `workbench` screen (the aggregate workbench and its typed surfaces); both are documented here, together with the printable-document bands used by `document` screens.

nouns.title: Pack
nouns.intro: A versioned, reusable bundle of concepts, flows, roles and screens that a model imports with the `packs` root key. This section lists the two shapes used to reference other files and packs; the keys of a pack file itself are in section 0.

nouns.title: Module
nouns.intro: Composition and evolution of a model: bounded contexts (`modules`, each a fragment file) and declarative data conversions that run at boot when the schema changes.

nouns.title: Property
nouns.intro: Runtime configuration resolved through a scoped cascade (for example tenant, then user), plus the app-level setting for delegating work to an outside AI.
